WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn
 FROM ledger WHERE business_date<='2026-10-23' AND datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')),
 active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status='active'),
 open AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.terms_code,i.discount_until,
 MAX(0,MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.invoice_id=i.event_key AND c.kind IN ('payment','credit')),0))-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.kind='hold'),0)) AS unheld
 FROM active i WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND i.due_date<='2026-10-30'),
 rated AS (SELECT o.event_key,o.unheld,
 CASE WHEN o.discount_until>='2026-10-23' THEN (SELECT t.discount_bps FROM active t WHERE t.kind='terms' AND t.terms_code=o.terms_code AND t.business_date<=o.business_date ORDER BY t.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE 0 END AS bps,
 (SELECT f.fx_num FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=o.currency AND f.business_date<=o.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS num,
 (SELECT f.fx_den FROM active f WHERE f.kind='fx' AND f.currency=o.currency AND f.business_date<=o.business_date ORDER BY f.business_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS den FROM open o)
 SELECT SUM((2*unheld*(10000-bps)*num+10000*den)/(20000*den)) AS total_usd_cents FROM rated WHERE 1=1

import json,itertools
c=json.loads(context)
vs={v['id']:v for v in c['vendors']}
opts=[]
for sku in 'ABCDE':
    z=c['skus'][sku]
    opts.append([q for q in c['quotes'] if q['sku']==sku and z['demand']<=q['units']<=z['demand']+2 and q['arrival']<=z['deadline'] and q['quality']=='approved'])
best=10**12
for choice in itertools.product(*opts):
    bysku={q['sku']:q for q in choice}
    vendor_ids=set(q['vendor'] for q in choice)
    if len(vendor_ids)<3 or sum(q['carbon'] for q in choice)>c['carbon_cap']:continue
    if any(q['needs_same_vendor_sku'] and bysku[q['needs_same_vendor_sku']]['vendor']!=q['vendor'] for q in choice):continue
    valid=True
    cost=0
    for vid in vendor_ids:
        qs=[q for q in choice if q['vendor']==vid]
        v=vs[vid]
        units=sum(q['units'] for q in qs)
        if units>v['unit_cap']:
            valid=False
            break
        gross=sum(q['units']*q['unit_cents'] for q in qs)
        bps=v['tier_bps'] if units>=v['tier_units'] else 0
        merchandise=(2*gross*(10000-bps)+10000)//20000
        cost+=merchandise+(0 if gross>=v['free_shipping_gross'] else v['shipping_cents'])
        if len(qs)>=2 and merchandise>=v['rebate_merchandise_min']:cost-=v['rebate_cents']
    if valid:best=min(best,cost)
print(FINAL(str(best)))
